newGroup.title: Engineered-cell source depth, retained catalogue assertions and illustration limits

review.auditor: Coordinator scoped follow-up intake; no additional curriculum coverage credit
review.rationale: Preserves the exact source-open curriculum clauses, source-depth limits, retained older assertions and illustration/product questions rather than certifying them through new notes or dates.

points.requirement: Frank model/gates/compartments, controls and 3–4-week/5-week kinetics require an accessible primary body. Complete abstract identity is resolved, while recorded BioC/efetch responses are errors or metadata-only and the publisher/PMC routes are blocked. These are the three source-blocked curriculum units.
